Black metal atgeir

Internal ID: AtgeirBlackmetal | Type: Polearm | Source: Forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Black metal x45, Linen thread x15 | Attack speed: 1.56 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 3.0 range, 360 angle, 1.0 height, 0.3 ray, no multitarget penalty | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. The Black metal atgeir is the third polearm.

Combat style. • Primary attack is a 3-stab combo with long reach and 2x damage on the last hit.
• Secondary attack is an AOE swing with a three-meter range that deals normal damage and 6x stagger with no multitarget penalty.

Upgrade information. Total cost for the fully upgraded polearm is 10 Finewood, 120 Black metal, and 35 Linen thread.

Notes. • The secondary attack is enough to stagger most creatures, which makes it optimal for crowd control.
• Despite the visual resembling a slash, the secondary attack deals piercing damage.
